summary: Decision research complete. Deliverable class (b) with a scoped exception: the per-regime split is the correct steady state, and the expansion should be re-tranched for a reason other than duplication. FINDING 1 -- the abstraction the task hypothesised ALREADY EXISTS and is instantiated at four systems: AuxStepPreserved/AuxBounds/ModalLoopInvHintikka/modalExpandBranchesHintikka (CompletenessLoop.lean:230-430, :1410) factors the world-bound conjunct out of the loop invariant into an opaque step-preserved Aux predicate so K's rank/potential argument and S5w's tag-cardinality argument share one structure (ModalLoopAuxK, ModalLoopAuxS5w, ModalLoopAuxFive, ModalLoopAuxKb5''). Regimes 1 and 3 are already spanned by one abstraction; that premise in the task description is out of date. Two machine-checked refutations (modalApplyOneS5_rankStep_not_dischargeable; the R7 fuel-domination refutation) show unification under a single CONCRETE measure was never available. FINDING 2 -- the state-threading generalisation also already exists (RuleApplySt ladder, Saturation.lean:493-758, tasks 562/564) with a live consumer bridged via modalExpandBranchesGenSt_eq_S4Keyed. FINDING 3 -- pushing further has been MEASURED and is negative: task 564 measured destructive redefinition of the bespoke S4 steppers as generic instantiations at net +80 lines across 40 proof sites, because those sites depend on the definitional SHAPE of the steppers. This is the Chronicle failure mode instrumented in this subsystem with a number attached. FINDING 4 (revised) -- the expansion gate is that S4 is not yet finished (soundness proven for the ordered driver, completeness for the keyed one; modalTableauS4Keyed_sound is FALSE with a machine-checked countermodel; no instDecidableS4Valid) -- but per task 511's re-verification this is a bounded ~580-line six-item four-phase within-file port against already-landed ordered lemmas, independent of any abstraction decision. The K4/D4 gate is real but LIGHT and already unblocked. FINDING 5 (new) -- rule-application ORDER is soundness-critical: the unsoundness was repaired by changing WHEN a minting shape may fire (settled-context scheduling), not the guard predicate. So a traversal abstraction is unsound-by-construction unless it carries the ordering obligation, since the schedule it would make instantiable is one for which soundness is machine-checked false. This downgrades the traversal rung from 'small and on the critical path' to 'optional and larger than sized', and supplies the strongest POSITIVE argument for the split: the ordered driver could only be built because the bespoke path let scheduling change independently of the guard predicate; a shared traversal abstraction would have obstructed the repair that made S4 sound. No .lean file created, moved, or edited.
